Max Vets Referral Hospital is a full-service Veterinary Hospital in East of Kailash that offers comprehensive medical services for cats, dogs and other small animals  in New Delhi and the surrounding areas. From preventive care to surgery, our broad and varied service offering can meet all of your pet’s health needs in one place.
services are
1.Preventive Health care
2.Internal Medicine
3. Gynecological Problems
4. Behavior Management
5.Weight management
6. Endocrinol Care
7. Micro chipping
8. Dermatology-Skin Care
9.Soft Tissue and orthopedic surgeries
10.Dentistry
11.Traumatology /critical care
12.Diagnostic Imaging
13 Ophthalmology
14 Cancer Therapy
15 Cardiology
16 Pharmaceuticals
17 Diagnostic Lab
18 Dietary Management
19 Pet Boarding
20 Pet Grooming
21 Pet Shop
22 Import/export services
23 Pet Transport
24 Emergency Services
http://www.maxvets.com/
https://www.facebook.com/maxvets
Contact no. 084484 49955
